title: What the Week Gathered

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The stall goes up before the slate comes out. The yard keeps its days in loaves and the fire keeps its four. A word that has gone around four times is no nearer home, and a hand held up an inch is no nearer the pot. Go around the line; it cost enough to come in. What the house gathers it does not count, and nobody is told what the number counts.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail kiln-house in the second working week of Grain

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and sixteen to two hundred and eighteen days, six months and thirty-six days to six months and thirty-eight days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing (the private file turned out as instruments on a towel, a cost asked as a direction answered with the pot and the weather, the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost, a saying taken apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound, a body read at two paces and worth nothing, and an inch of a small hand asked again under a roof the market cannot enter) without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector or back-room interior, no new hearing beyond six, no seventh, no tenth stopping before the seventh year is earned and still not given, no third telling of the shut counting room, no opening, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no seventh green or seventh sighting of the foundling, no calling of the loan, no payer named, no private record read and no ending

scenes.title: The Week Opens Without a Boundary
scenes.synopsis: First entry, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 216, Grain 7, Seventhday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning. No recap: the hand lies down against the fold after the letting-go of the night before and that coordination is not recalled as a sign, a growth or a reaching. The boy is two hundred and sixteen days old and six months and thirty-six days, told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for two hundred and sixteen days (T088); through a finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water, a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings, and overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- three counts in three places that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. One leathery brown-edged crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool is frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. The file is turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid with the pot that sang early and is not heard from among them, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Ember's third reading gone up the clay road in Berr's locked box and still not the figure paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth, the held inch on a sixth, and the burned-slate word told three times on its own place beside Jorra's dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three (T061/T082, T036/T076, T006, T035/T031/T065/T095). An empty place kept empty is a finding; a finding filled to make a row even is forged. Word comes up the clay road that stalls are being set at the Cross against Grain 10 and a neighbour goes up with boards, but there is no market and no Account-day in these three days and the yard's arithmetic stays in loaves, glances, arms and the weather (T077). Sella comes to the fire before the basket: instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind, never the basket; the house, not I; half-pace from every open slate; glance at the cold clay jar and hand shut half over nothing without a touch; lips along a row with two unnamed gaps and no figure; finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread; pot rim set out with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, a half-beat longer at the setting, no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in thirty-six days (T058/T079, T100). A neighbour's cost-question at the door goes to the pot and the weather and away level, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather and the field's empty place, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098). Morning hand: up an inch toward the note, down at once against the fold --- a miss, and no failure in it; filed on the sixth place, laid across nothing, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Fire Kept
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 216, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; heat goes off the high air first and stays longest under the shelf, behind the pot and in the fold where one stiff crust keeps its empty place unnamed and no third comes; the underside of the shelf becomes a roof that stops where his hand stops; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting. Garl is kept in objects and not in a story: the salt-stiff coat holds a broader man's shape with the crease at the left shoulder, the seat its twenty-year hollow and leftward lean, the clean dark line and the new finer hairline called the thaw unswept, the proverb about leaving the crack showing gone to a pot with no crack in it, and the debt against a firing of tiles circled without a name and worse for being uncalled; no lesson made, no collector called, name unspoken for two hundred and sixteen days (T009/T013/T092). Sella stands with her back to the basket, moves her lips along a two-gapped row and gives nobody a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it and stands counting under her breath toward no opening; the mark hangs where it hung, not touched at an afternoon and a dusk, because neither is an opening and there has been no opening since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill with six counted where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it. The sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it comes to his teeth and stops at the word that would call the loan, no figure and no name, drawn breath unspent; nine stoppings still nine objects with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled; he says Yes, house to the fire, sweeps the flagstones past the shallow bright patch without the half-check and the road toward a collector without a turn; no collector came on Grain 7; the warm stone lies cold and unreconciled in its unmarked pot in the Debt Loft with the loft-sill scrape on its fourth place (T036/T076, T006, T062). Jorra comes through from the shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground past the bent finger and under the nails, white in a knuckle where a fist opened, not bone-coloured slip; dusty and clean forearms on one tray, parted as clot from vessel; men unnamed went low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey and got no name, the room not called cold, the two shut-room tellings still two and the burned-slate word still a direction arrived nowhere; he speaks to the wheel (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, withholds the full note he knows it will give three turns ahead, and when Sella's voice goes low and unfinished his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper and holds until her sentence reaches the pot, then moves a hair's breadth and is left standing --- a remembered repetition, not a change made again, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars and river wind behind with the taste of water over water, wide around the pan's gone ring, bare trough, rack space with broken birth-slates, field's empty place and carriers' place, each with a look and a wide step; carrying arm a record in muscle that remembers weight and not cost; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: hand up an inch toward the note, held for the small intake only, down before the letting go --- an honest fraction on its sixth place, no hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Saying Turns Back
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 217, Grain 8, Eighthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning and midday at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the wheel-shed edge and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: the boy is two hundred and seventeen days old and six months and thirty-seven days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth is unpaid for two hundred and seventeen days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap. The chapter's one meaningful change, small and non-fatal, gathered and not paid: a kiln-hand come up from High Kiln with a barrow says over the boards, on a wrong wind, that there is a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw. The singular report of one pot's silence bends back toward the old general proverb, so that three shapings of the same saying stand on one tray --- sings itself out early, has not been heard from since, and gone quiet on every row --- and the boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound, refusing to let three likenesses stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and no payer stands to any shaping (T061/T082 near-full tray advanced and unpaid, T064, T035/T031). The sweet edge of lead glaze rides up off High Kiln on the wrong wind and goes out on it, a direction and not a second edge paid. Jorra, who knew that pot's full note three turns before it left his hands and holds the nearly-full answer with air under it and a want in it, lets the saying stand as a saying; he gives no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, makes no lesson of the green on the wind, and no pot is lost. The knowing stays on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; no seventh hearing comes, no cause stands up and nothing is spent. At the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asks what the month's pots will want now the firing is done, and a man off the clay road keeps a number shut in his fist; both go to the pot and the weather and arrive nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered, while the printed one in twelve stands unchallenged and the true subtraction stays locked in Berr's box up the road (T077, T015/T041/T047 held). Sella's instruction grammar, the house, half-pace, jar-glance and hand half-shut, lips along the two-gapped row, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in thirty-seven days (T058/T079, T100). Morning hand: up an inch, down before the counted breath has finished --- an honest miss filed on its sixth place and laid across nothing (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Day Left Where It Lay
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 217, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; one stiff leathery brown-edged crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed, no third; the thread is frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. Sella at the shelf with her back to the basket: lips along a two-gapped row, jar-glance and hand half-shut, finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath, mark untouched at an afternoon and a dusk --- no opening in thirty-seven days (T058/T079, T100). Garl a coat, a hollow seat, two unswept lines and a proverb gone to the pot; tile debt neither paid nor settled; name unspoken for two hundred and seventeen days (T009/T013/T092). The turned saying stays a saying on the near-full tray with no lesson made and no pot lost (T061/T082). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count with the knife at the lip and Garl's unforged sentence beside it; the ear-sentence comes once more to the word that would call the loan and stops with no figure and no name --- paid, if paid at all, as an interval and not as a calling of the loan, breath drawn at the top of the reach and not spent; nine stoppings still nine objects with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; Seed 16 breath unspent; loan uncalled; Yes, house; broom over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without a turn; no collector came on Grain 8; stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T061/T082, T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean ones, asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate; all three sayings about the pot stand as sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188; pot told You'll do; Sella's voice goes low and unfinished and his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of her hand, holds until the sentence reaches the pot, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing as a remembered repetition; the two shut-room tellings stay two, the burned-slate word stays a direction arrived nowhere, he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Carry home around the absences at the going of the light; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: hand up an inch and, with no count anywhere in the house, keeps the river's own low interval --- draw, slack, small pause --- down on the next low note: the one-rhythm coordination remembered, not a change made again, filed on the sixth place and laid across nothing; no payer named (T061/T082). Count 217 exact and unspent; fire in the room that warms him, river in the room he cannot enter, neither stopping for the ear.

scenes.title: The Fourth Telling
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 218, Grain 9, Ninthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the wheel-shed edge. New day, new date, no recap: the boy is two hundred and eighteen days old and six months and thirty-eight days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth is unpaid for two hundred and eighteen days (T088); three counts in three places do not become one (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap. The burned-slate word comes around the boards of the yard once more, a fourth telling from Slate Row, spoken over the boards and not to the basket on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather; nobody names whose slate, which room, who set the flame or why. It is a fourth telling of the burned slate and still not a third telling of the counting room shut in the war, which stays at two; the boy takes it apart and sets it on its own place beside Jorra's meal-fine dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three --- a direction arrived nowhere, not a cause, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment and nothing a clerk could chart (T035/T031/T065/T095 advanced, not paid). Jorra grows quieter whenever it goes around and the household straightens around the quiet without an order; the quiet goes before him into the shed the way a cold air goes before a door; he's not Vail stays sealed, the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, and the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack stay entered by nobody. Cost-questions: a neighbour at the door about the stalls going up for the tenth and a rack woman at the well about the pots' cost --- both to the pot and the weather, going away level, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077, T058/T079). Word goes up the clay road of boards carried toward the Cross and of the reading block that will be used on the morrow, but the market has not come and no slate is opened under any roof; Berr's box stays locked up the road, Hessa's slate unread, the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). Sella's instruction grammar, the house, half-pace, jar-glance and hand half-shut, lips along the two-gapped row, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the hand; mark untouched, no opening in thirty-eight days; private roll unshown, Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn's knife stays at the lip with six counted and the seventh where the house cannot check, Seed 16 breath unspent, ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping and not a new one, nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, no collector on Grain 9 (T036/T076). Sella's voice goes low and unfinished; Jorra's finger stands in the damper until the end reaches the pot (T062). Morning hand: up an inch toward the note, down at once against the fold --- a miss under conditions that have sometimes answered, and no failure in it; filed on the sixth place, no payer named (T061/T082). Grain 10 held three mornings off: the seventh green stays a colour and the foundling a shape, with no loaf, no slate and no sale coming early (T050/T051, T033/T034 held).

scenes.title: Before the Market
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 218, Grain 9, Ninthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending and heat settles in the low places under the shelf, behind the pot and in the fold where one stiff brown-edged crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread is frozen and unwiped and cold has stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. Sella stands with her back to the basket, moves her lips along a row standing with two unnamed gaps and gives nobody a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, uncounted and uncopied, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, stands with the back of the pot in her hand counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and lets her hand rest a half-beat longer at the setting, and does not look toward the bed; the mark hangs where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since --- no opening in thirty-eight days --- and the private roll stays unshown (T058/T079, T100). Garl is kept to the day without a story: coat, hollow seat, unswept lines, proverb gone to the pot, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor named, no lesson, no collector, name unspoken for two hundred and eighteen days (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, knife at the very edge, ear-sentence stopping short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled; stroke over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without a turn; no collector on Grain 9; stone cold in its unmarked loft pot, loft scrape on its fourth place (T036/T076, T006, T062). Jorra with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, pot told You'll do; all three sayings about the pot stand as sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188; the burned-slate word a fourth direction arrived nowhere, the two shut-room tellings still two, his bent finger held in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T061/T082/T065/T095). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars, river wind behind with the taste of water over water, wide around the pan's gone ring, bare trough, rack space with broken birth-slates, field's empty place and carriers' place, each with a look and a wide step and no number; carrying arm remembers weight and not cost; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing --- six hearings with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers now holding three shapings of the pot saying advanced and unpaid, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no payer, three held changes on three places with loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth, held inch sixth, burned-slate word on its own place with a hand between the three; no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, nothing filled to make a row come out even (T061/T082, T036/T076, T035/T031). The hand is asked: up an inch toward the note and, with Sella gone to her bed and the two rooms not touching, taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire, kept through the little silence after her count has ended and brought down on the river's next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a longer reach, a miss, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule, filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082). He still cannot close two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number. Two hundred and eighteen stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and eighteen days; seventh year at its very end and ungiven; Grain 10 (Day 219) held three mornings off as the first Account-day and first market of the month, the first reading of Grain, with the seventh green a colour and the foundling a shape and no loaf, slate or sale coming early. Forward into Day 219, Grain 10, Tenthday (Chapter 56).
